description: Extract photos from Google Maps places.

enrichDetails.description: When enabled, reads each photo's metadata: contributor name/URL, observed upload date, original dimensions, aspect ratio, orientation, caption, and tags. Disable for thumbnail-level rows (photo/thumbnail URL, business context, category, video flag and duration). Every surface is walked in both modes, so disabling trims per-photo work instead of skipping the walk.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich Photo Details

maxPhotos.description: Maximum number of photos to extract (1-100000). Google may expose fewer photos for a place or category.
maxPhotos.title: Max Photos

placeId.description: Canonical Google Place ID beginning with ChIJ. Use this instead of placeUrl when available.
placeId.title: Google Place ID

placeUrl.description: Google Maps URL of the place to scrape photos from.
placeUrl.title: Place URL

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Direct access is tried first; bounded recovery uses the hardcoded US RESIDENTIAL group unless direct-only mode is explicitly selected with useApifyProxy=false.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Google Maps Photos Scraper
